# Nakasendo Indoors

> The Nakasendo's indoor experience: the Nerikiri Challenge, a hands-on wagashi (Japanese sweets) workshop
> in Nagiso, Kiso Valley, Nagano, Japan. Run by From Scratch LLC. The teacher and an English interpreter come to the inn where you are staying.

## The Nerikiri Challenge

- What: the teacher and an interpreter come to the inn where you are staying; you shape nerikiri — delicate seasonal Japanese
  sweets made from white-bean paste — then eat them with matcha.
- Teacher: Makiko Koide, Kiso-born licensed confectioner (seika eiseishi), 3 years' training in Tokyo.
  Interpreted into English. No experience needed; families welcome.
- Length: about 2 hours. Also a one-hour Early Morning Session, 7–8 am.
- Dates: by arrangement.
- Booking: the Early Morning Session (7–8 am) can be requested 2 days ahead; other times, about a month ahead. Requests are confirmed only when the teacher and interpreter are both free. First message us on WhatsApp or LINE with your preferred date and group size.
- Price (opening offer): ¥2,000 per group + ¥2,000 per person (e.g. ¥6,000 for two).
- Entirely indoors, so it works in any weather.
